title: Wara Wara Wars: Gekitou! Daigundan Battle
native_title: ワラ・ワラ・ウォーズ ～激闘！大軍団バトル～
overview:
Lead a huge army thousands strong and aim to conquer the entire continent!!

Wara Wara Wars: Gekitou! Daigundan Battle is a turn-based war simulation built to be easy to pick up, with simple commands and few numbers to manage. Choose one of 10 nations and conquer the other nine to unite the continent.

On the map you move your forces, scout, collect taxes to fund your war chest, and recruit and train soldiers of various classes. When armies meet, the battle plays out in real time as more than 100 troops per side clash in their special formations. Every army also has a mighty guardian deity that can appear with flashy visuals and turn the tide at the right moment.

- Command armies thousands strong
- Battles of 100 versus 100 or more
- One player, memory backup saves

総勢数千人の大軍団を率いて、全大陸制覇を目指せ！！
